title: An upload API for images, audio, and video
summary:
A new media upload API, more creative options, steadier chat requests, and a clearer path through the project.

Added a media service that accepts multipart files, raw binary, or base64 JSON and returns a public URL. Uploads have a 24 MB limit, and identical files reuse the same stored object.

Added the alpha `grok-imagine` image model and support for custom ElevenLabs voice IDs alongside speech presets. Imagen 4, Grok video, and Qwen Character were re-enabled; Grok video now preserves multiple reference images. After several routing changes, Wan 2.6 video requests now go directly to Alibaba DashScope.

Text requests no longer pass Anthropic-specific `cache_control` to providers that reject it, and direct Anthropic requests get a `max_tokens` default when callers omit one. Polly now returns an OpenAI-shaped chat completion with token usage and passes supported generation parameters through to its underlying model.

highlights.title: Upload media by API
highlights.text: Upload images, audio, or video as a file, raw binary, or base64 JSON, and get a public URL back. [Explore the media service](https://media.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Grok Imagine images
highlights.text: Generate images from text prompts with the alpha `grok-imagine` model, with square, portrait, and landscape sizes. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-imagine).

highlights.title: Your ElevenLabs voice IDs
highlights.text: Use a custom ElevenLabs voice ID in the speech API’s `voice` field; the existing voice presets still work. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Find your way in
highlights.text: The redesigned Hello and Community pages make it easier to find contribution paths, the roadmap, and how Pollen works. [Explore pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).
